# pangolin_resource_user (Resource)

Assigns a user to a Pangolin HTTP resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_resource_user" "example" {
  resource_id = pangolin_resource.example.id
  user_id     = pangolin_user.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_id` (Number) The ID of the HTTP resource.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user to assign.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Composite ID: {resource_id}/{user_id}
terraform import pangolin_resource_user.example 42/u-abc123
```
